subject: general
question: In Hinduism the god/goddess ___________ was the integral form of the “Lord of Trees”, healer of disease and bestower of wealth.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Som**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Som** is an integral deity in Hinduism, often associated with the moon and vegetation.
 
• Som is also known as the healer of diseases and bestower of wealth.
